# Is that trade show booth worth it, and which shows should you buy?

> Paste the trade shows and conferences you could exhibit at and get cost per lead, expected deals, ROI and break-even leads for each, plus the exact set of shows that earns the most under your yearly budget. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
